defs.def: to see or notice sb/sth 看到；注意到；观察到

ex.s: But as Aristotle observed over 2,000 years ago, actions pushed to their extreme turn into disasters.
ex.t: 请听众贡献他们的想法，或者让他们参与向他人解释新概念和政策。

ex.s: When John Todd was a child he loved to explore the woods around his house, observing how nature solved problems.
ex.t: 当约翰·托德还是个孩子的时候，他喜欢探索房子周围的树林，观察大自然如何解决问题。

ex.s: After studying agriculture, medicine, and fisheries in college, John went back to observing nature and asking questions.
ex.t: 在大学学习了农业、医学和渔业后，约翰回到观察大自然并提出问题。

ex.s: “You put organisms in new relationships and observe what’s happening.
ex.t: “你把生物放进新的关系中，然后观察会发生什么。

ex.s: So I was shocked when, not long after the email, Professor Mary Devon, who was running the programme, invited me to observe the work being done in her lab.
ex.t: 所以，在那封邮件之后不久，负责该项目的玛丽·德文教授邀请我去观察她的实验室工作时，我感到非常震惊。

ex.s: From observing his mum and from his desire to give kids better drink options, he came up with his original model for the Fun Bottle.
ex.t: 从观察他妈妈和他想给孩子们更好的饮料选择的愿望出发，他想出了Fun Bottle的原始设计模型。

ex.s: The question,“What do elephants and fish have in common?" may sound strange but researchers have found that they both have a feature not observed in any other creature.
ex.t: "大象和鱼有什么共同点？"这个问题听起来可能很奇怪，但研究人员发现它们都有一个在其他生物身上没有观察到的特征。

ex.s: Observing other creatures.
ex.t: 观察其他生物。

ex.s: To observe their differences.
ex.t: 教它们生存技能。

ex.s: observe the President at a right angle
ex.t: 让所有工具触手可及

ex.s: Observe the unknown around you.
ex.t: 你可以做些什么来重新找回好奇心和不满？（    ）

ex.s: 7．（1分）We can observe that artificial intelligence has already made a（n） ________on our lives in many ways．（  ）
ex.t: 7．（1分）我们可以观察到，人工智能已经在许多方面对我们的生活产生了________。（  ）

ex.s: I was searching   67    these three western lowland gorillas I’d been observing.
ex.t: 我正在寻找____67____这三只我一直在观察的西部低地大猩猩。

ex.s: Colonel Evans Carlson of the United States Marine3 Corps4 observed these cooperatives while he was in China.
ex.t: 美国海军陆战队埃文斯·卡尔森上校在中国时注意到了这些合作社。

ex.s: This educational method was first observed in 2012 by Sonia Kleindorfer, a biologist at Flinders University in South Australia, and her colleagues.
ex.t: 远非向消费者收取高价，许多这类服务都是免费的（用户实际上是通过交出更多数据来付费的）。

ex.s: Han Gan’s method, however, was different - he observed the animal itself.
ex.t: 然而，韩幹的方法不同——他观察动物本身。

ex.s: Recently, I asked a friend who had just returned from a long walk in the woods what she had observed.
ex.t: 最近，我问一位刚从树林里长距离散步回来的朋友她观察到了什么。

ex.s: He listened to their stories and observed their day-to-day lives, as well as conducting interviews with Mao Zedong and other leaders.
ex.t: 他聆听他们的故事，观察他们的日常生活，也采访了毛泽东和其他领导人。

defs.def: to watch sb/sth carefully, especially to learn more about them 观察；注视；监视

ex.s: The researchers observed that the dogs were much more patient, making more eye contact and staying closer to the screen after the “unable” scenario played out.
ex.t: 你姐姐是个好游泳运动员；你肯定也是。"然而她拒绝承认的是，我明显怕水。

ex.s: Most of us observed much more as children than we do as adults.
ex.t: 重新学会观察周围世界的艺术虽然很简单，但需要练习并需要打破一些不良习惯。

ex.s: One of the best things about this job is that you can observe animals in their natural environment.
ex.t: 这份工作最好的地方之一就是你可以观察自然环境中的动物。

defs.def: to make a remark 说话；评论

ex.s: After years of observing human nature, I have decided that two qualities make the difference between men of great achievement and men of average performance curioscy and discontent.
ex.t: 录音师如何在录音棚工作。

defs.def: to obey rules, laws, etc. 遵守（规则、法律等）

ex.s: Observe existing regulations on it.
ex.t: 遵守现行相关法规。

ex.s: With a different theme each year, the day Is observed with a wide range of events that are organised at local, national and international levels.
ex.t: 每年有一个不同的主题，这一天通过各种在地方、国家和国际层面组织的活动来纪念。

defs.def: to celebrate festivals, birthdays, etc. 庆祝；庆贺；欢度
